title: Qualify wide Jackson and Commons Lang conversions and classify ties
description: Check the original five native and staged JBMC statements first, including direct double input, full 2^54 long range and exact JVM counterexamples. After those ten answers qualify, check the independent characterization in both engines and record the separately scoped opcode and mantissa controls. Compare the physical signed zero and double-rounding bits and the 8192-bin grid.

steps.name: Five original conversions
steps.run: python3 -B lib/benchmark/jbmc-fast-follow/measure.py qualified numeric paired --cohort numeric --require

steps.name: All 16777216 disagreements
steps.run: python3 -B lib/benchmark/jbmc-fast-follow/measure.py classification numeric paired --cohort classification --require

steps.name: Independent opcode and mantissa controls
steps.run: python3 -B lib/benchmark/jbmc-fast-follow/measure.py controls numeric paired --cohort intrinsic mantissa
